mapper.select: SELECT quotation_id, shipper_id, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, cargo_type, weight_kg, estimated_amount, estimated_currency, valid_until, status, created_at, updated_at, version FROM quotation WHERE quotation_id = #{quotationId}
SELECT candidate_seq, estimated_days, estimated_cost, estimated_currency, itinerary_summary FROM quotation_candidate WHERE quotation_id = #{quotationId} ORDER BY candidate_seq

SELECT quotation_id, shipper_id, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, cargo_type, weight_kg, estimated_amount, estimated_currency, valid_until, status, created_at, updated_at, version FROM quotation ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
